title: cloud continuity tutorial / 1. Choose a repository
content: ## 1. Choose a repository Choose a repository from your own projects that is available for cloud sessions. Pick a small project or focus on one feature to keep the exploration manageable. The task only reads repository files and returns its findings in the conversation. You don't need to install dependencies or run the project for this walkthrough. The cloud session works with the code available on GitHub.com. Uncommitted changes, local dependencies, and files that exist only on your computer aren't copied to the cloud environment.
